description: This file implements an in-memory message broker for tracking order events, allowing subscription, unsubscription, and publishing of messages related to specific order IDs. It defines data classes for message serialization and manages concurrent access with asyncio locks.

classes.name: BrokerMessage
classes.description: A data class representing a serializable message with a type and payload, used for communicating order events.

classes.name: OrderEventBroker
classes.description: An in-memory broker managing subscriptions and message delivery for order IDs, supporting fan-out to multiple subscribers.

methods.name: str to_json(self)
methods.description: Serializes the BrokerMessage instance to a JSON string.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the broker with a lock and an empty subscriber dictionary.

methods.name: asyncio.Queue[BrokerMessage] subscribe(self, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Creates a new asyncio.Queue for a given order ID and adds it to the subscribers set.

methods.name: None unsubscribe(self, order_id: UUID, q: asyncio.Queue[BrokerMessage])
methods.description: Removes a subscriber queue for a given order ID, cleaning up if no subscribers remain.

methods.name: None publish(self, order_id: UUID, msg: BrokerMessage)
methods.description: Publishes a message to all subscriber queues associated with a specific order ID, handling full queues gracefully.

methods.name: None publish_tracking_event(order_id: UUID, event_payload: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: publish
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish(self, order_id: UUID, msg: BrokerMessage) -> None:$/

ctags.name: publish_tracking_event
ctags.pattern: /^async def publish_tracking_event(order_id: UUID, event_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, order_id: UUID) -> asyncio.Queue[BrokerMessage]:$/

ctags.name: unsubscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unsubscribe(self, order_id: UUID, q: asyncio.Queue[BrokerMessage]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: unsubscribe_order
ctags.pattern: /^async def unsubscribe_order(order_id: UUID, q: asyncio.Queue[BrokerMessage]) -> None:$/
